task.notes: Read H of the tournament, T1's cardiomyocytes from E8.5 to E9.5: the read no counted candidate has run on. It is not a clean read. The direction readout's smoke read Feng's real direction (E9.5 -> E14.5) within cardiomyocytes on exactly this transition with the scorer's metric family (the committed experiments/t1_direction/results/smoke_E8.5_E9.5/per_type.csv, type CM, predictor feng_E14.5, target full, held flat: sign agreement 0.717, Spearman 0.428, de_direction 0.296, de_score 0.084 against a chance of 0.056; predictor feng_E15.5: 0.681, 0.374, 0.265, 0.067). A named known feature: a pass here is consistent with that concordance and is no independent evidence that a late Feng bracket transfers. Within type it carries no chamber mix. Cut to E8.5's and E9.5's cardiomyocyte labels by configs/t1_chamber_classes.yaml.
